reviews.text: My new favorite moisturizer!! So lightweight and absorbs sooo fast and not sticky at all perfect for oily skin in humid climate! Calms my acne and redness and doesn't break me out
reviews.zh: 我嘅新寵保濕霜！！超輕盈，吸收快到爆，完全唔黐笠，啱晒油性肌喺潮濕天氣用！可以舒緩暗瘡同泛紅，而且唔會令我爆瘡。

reviews.text: I’m on adapalene and I use 147 for night and I wanted a light one for a morning routine. Loved it. Although I didn’t like the product being in a jar, I prefer cream in a tube.
reviews.zh: 我有用阿達帕林（adapalene），夜晚用 147 號，想搵一隻清爽啲嘅用喺早上。鍾意。不過唔鍾意用 jar 裝嘅設計，我比較鍾意用 tube 裝嘅面霜。

reviews.text: the texture of the product is incredibly light and absorbs into my skin almost instantly without leaving any greasy residue behind. What I appreciate most is how gentle it is on my skin; even after using it for several days, I haven't experienced any irritation or breakouts
reviews.zh: 質地輕到不得了，幾乎即刻就吸收，唔會留低任何油膩感。最欣賞嘅係佢對皮膚好溫和，用咗幾日都冇出現任何刺激或者爆瘡。

reviews.text: I love the feel of this moisturizer and it absorbs so fast and easily. I have rosacea and I feel like it’s helped calm down some of the redness and it feels cooling to the skin. Worth a try.
reviews.zh: 鍾意呢隻保濕霜嘅觸感，吸收得快又順。我有玫瑰痤瘡，覺得佢有幫助舒緩泛紅，搽上面有涼浸浸嘅感覺。值得一試。

reviews.text: This is an excellent day moisturizer for oily acne-prone skin, it is very lightweight yet hydrating, absorbs quickly, and effectively soothes active breakouts. My only complaint is that I wish it was also offered in a tube (like the mini versions bundled with the Balanceful serums) and not just a jar as I find the packaging inconvenient.
reviews.zh: 呢隻日霜對油性同容易爆瘡嘅肌膚嚟講真係一流，質地好輕但好保濕，吸收得快，對於活躍中嘅暗瘡都有舒緩效果。我唯一嘅投訴係希望佢有出支裝（好似跟住 Balanceful 精華附送嘅細支咁），而唔係淨係得罐裝，因為我覺得罐裝包裝好唔方便。

reviews.text: I LOVE this cream! First of all, I didn’t expect how cold it would be but I like it! The soothing is insane. I applied this on a red swollen pimple and within minutes there was a noticeable difference. A little goes a long way as well, I use a chickpea sized bead for my whole face. Goes on a little tacky but it absorbs quickly and feels so so nice.
reviews.zh: 我勁鍾意呢隻面霜！首先，我冇諗過佢會咁凍但我鍾意！舒緩效果勁到癲。我搽咗喺一顆紅腫暗瘡上面，幾分鐘之內已經見到明顯分別。少量已經好夠用，我用一粒鷹嘴豆咁大嘅分量就搽到成塊面。搽上去有少少黐但好快就吸收，感覺好舒服。

reviews.text: Light- weight gel cream that's non-sticky and absorbs nicely. The formulation is wonderful but unfortunately I had to subtract a star for the unhygienic jar style packaging. Why is it not in a tube?!
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈嘅gel狀面霜，唔黐笠，吸收得好好。配方好正，但可惜因為嗰個唔衛生嘅罐裝包裝要扣一粒星。點解唔出支裝？！

reviews.text: Oh my goodness this is hands down my FAVORITE gel moisturizer! It provides an All Day glow without any heavy weight to it and yet it's rich enough to work as a night cream! Love it Love it Love it! Looking forward to trying the Dive-In Series next!!
reviews.zh: 天啊，呢隻絕對係我最鍾意嘅gel狀保濕！提供全日水光感但完全冇厚重感，而且豐潤度足夠當晚霜用！鍾意鍾意鍾意！好期待試 Dive-In Series！！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
